description: This file defines the StatementInterface interface within the Drupal core database namespace, outlining methods for executing and fetching results from prepared database statements.

classes.name: StatementInterface
classes.description: Interface for a prepared database statement, including methods for execution, fetching, and setting fetch modes.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a prepared statement with optional arguments and options.

methods.name: getQueryString
methods.description: Returns the SQL query string with placeholders.

methods.name: getConnectionTarget
methods.description: Returns the target connection string associated with the statement.

methods.name: rowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows matched by the last SQL statement or throws an exception.

methods.name: setFetchMode
methods.description: Sets the default fetch mode for retrieving results.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches the next row from the result set in various formats.

methods.name: fetchField
methods.description: Returns a single field from the next record.

methods.name: fetchObject
methods.description: Fetches the next row as an object of a specified class.

methods.name: fetchAssoc
methods.description: Fetches the next row as an associative array.

methods.name: fetchAll
methods.description: Returns all rows in the result set in various formats.

methods.name: fetchCol
methods.description: Returns a single column from all rows as an indexed array.

methods.name: fetchAllKeyed
methods.description: Returns all rows as an associative array keyed by a specified column.

methods.name: fetchAllAssoc
methods.description: Returns all rows as an associative array indexed by a specified field.
